# AI Chip Packaging Stack

> How an AI GPU's signal crosses four carriers — die & HBM, advanced packaging (CoWoS), IC substrate (ABF) and PCB — with the materials, suppliers, bottlenecks, cost breakdown and an HBM demand cascade for NVIDIA GB200/GB300/Vera Rubin racks.
